onboarding.intro: I'll be your AI assistant. When you show me your work, I watch, ask why at the right moments and remember it, so your know-how can help the next person. When you're learning something new, I'm right next to you, in your expert's own words. How should I work with you?
onboarding.styles.quiet.title: Silent observer
onboarding.styles.quiet.description: I watch and stay out of your way. I only speak up for what really matters: a limit, an exception or a mistake.
onboarding.styles.normal.title: Balanced
onboarding.styles.normal.description: A few questions at natural pauses, and help whenever you ask. Everything else waits until you're done.
onboarding.styles.curious.title: Active coach
onboarding.styles.curious.description: I ask more as you go and offer tips along the way, without you having to ask first.

onboarding.intro: I'll be your AI assistant. When you show me your work, I watch, ask why at the right moments and remember it, so your know-how can help the next person. When you're learning something new, I'm right next to you, in your expert's own words. How should I work with you?
onboarding.styles.quiet.title: Silent observer
onboarding.styles.quiet.description: I watch and stay out of your way. I only speak up for what really matters: a limit, an exception or a mistake.
onboarding.styles.normal.title: Balanced
onboarding.styles.normal.description: A few questions at natural pauses, and help whenever you ask. Everything else waits until you're done.
onboarding.styles.curious.title: Active coach
onboarding.styles.curious.description: I ask more as you go and offer tips along the way, without you having to ask first.
